title: Village Market Crossroads
description: Four-direction village market crossroad with a clear central turning court, two orthogonal complete produce-stall frontages, separate southwest delivery pocket and northeast notice forecourt. Four unit-scale rigid complete original placements of three original IDs on one scene-only support slab. Static finite empty volumes only; no continuous navigation, accessibility, vehicle turning, functional trade, load or safety certification. The intact canopy, counter, trays and produce remain in both stalls. No recolor, deleted part or rescaled original; the external slab edge is 0.06m high and requires site placement.
